 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Repeat the central pixel-art motif vertically, recoloring from the palette strip."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The motif is the connected component made from color 1, excluding the palette.
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    # Find 8-connected components; the long palette stripe is separate from the motif.
    unseen = set(pts)
    comps = []
    while unseen:
        start = unseen.pop()
        comp = {start}
        stack = [start]
        while stack:
            r, c = stack.pop()
            for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
                for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                    q = (r + dr, c + dc)
                    if q in unseen:
                        unseen.remove(q)
                        comp.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    # Pick the component that is not part of a solid repeated-row/column palette bar.
    motif = max(comps, key=len)
    # Locate the 3-row palette bar (same sequence repeated in every row).
    palette = None
    for r0 in range(h - 2):
        for c0 in range(w):
            for length in range(3, w - c0 + 1):
                seq = [grid[r0][c0 + j] for j in range(length)]
                if all(v != 0 for v in seq) and len(set(seq)) == length and all(
                    grid[r0 + dr][c0:c0 + length] == seq for dr in range(1, 3)
                ):
                    palette = seq
                    break
            if palette is not None:
                break
        if palette is not None:
            break
    if palette is None:
        # Vertical orientation: each palette color occupies one repeated column.
        for r0 in range(h):
            for c0 in range(w - 2):
                for length in range(3, h - r0 + 1):
                    seq = [grid[r0 + j][c0] for j in range(length)]
                    if all(v != 0 for v in seq) and len(set(seq)) == length and all(
                        [grid[r0 + j][c0 + dc] for j in range(length)] == seq for dc in (1, 2)
                    ):
                        palette = seq
                        break
                if palette is not None:
                    break
            if palette is not None:
                break
    if palette is None:
        raise ValueError('palette stripe not found')

    rmin = min(r for r, c in motif)
    cmin = min(c for r, c in motif)
    shape = {(r - rmin, c - cmin) for r, c in motif}
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    # The existing color-1 motif marks the palette's color-1 position.
    anchor = palette.index(1)
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    # Center the stack on the original motif, preserving its location.
    for i, color in enumerate(palette):
        top = rmin + (i - anchor) * sh
        for dr, dc in shape:
            rr, cc = top + dr, cmin + dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
